priorityList: Pre-combat: Summon your pet (if Unbreakable Bond is talented) and use Steady Shot.
Cast Multi-Shot if the Trick Shots buff is inactive or to spend Precise Shots stacks.
Cast Rapid Fire if your Bulletstorm buff is about to expire before your next Aimed Shot.
Activate Trueshot whenever it is available.
Cast Volley on cooldown to trigger the Trick Shots effect.
Cast Aimed Shot while Trick Shots is active, prioritizing targets with the Sentinel's Mark debuff.
Cast Rapid Fire while Trick Shots is active.
Use Steady Shot as a filler to generate Focus when no other abilities are available.
Use offensive racial abilities (such as Berserking, Blood Fury, or Ancestral Call) while Trueshot is active.
Use on-use trinkets during Trueshot windows, specifically synchronizing them with the 2-minute cooldown.
Use a combat potion during Trueshot, ideally when paired with Bloodlust or when the fight is nearly over.
